name: Dialog
description: Controlled modal surface for a short blocking task or consequential choice. Dialog owns modal presentation, focus containment, dismissal requests, and composition; the containing workflow owns business state, request progression, validation, dirty checks, and action outcomes.

props.name: open
props.description: Required controlled visibility state. The containing workflow owns the value and responds to close requests through onOpenChange.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Required callback for component-owned close requests such as the close Icon Button or Escape key. The component never owns request or business progression.

props.name: title
props.description: Required visible dialog heading and accessible name source.

props.name: description
props.description: Optional visible supporting context. Its presence derives Figma showDescription and the runtime aria-describedby relationship.

props.name: children
props.description: Required Body slot content. Product patterns compose fields, choices, explanatory content, and feedback here; Dialog does not interpret them.

props.name: actions
props.description: Optional Actions slot content. Use public Button composition; Dialog does not interpret labels, hierarchy, pending state, or outcomes.

props.name: showClose
props.description: Controls the visible close Icon Button only. Hiding it does not change Escape behavior or define workflow exit policy.

props.name: closeLabel
props.description: Accessible label for the close Icon Button. Defaults to Close dialog and should be localized by the consuming product when needed.

props.name: initialFocusRef
props.description: Optional runtime focus target inside the Dialog. When absent, focus moves to the first focusable descendant or the dialog surface itself.

anatomy.name: backdrop
anatomy.description: Viewport-covering modal backdrop. Pointer activation on the backdrop does not dismiss Dialog in version 1.0.0.

anatomy.name: surface
anatomy.description: 520px maximum-width elevated modal surface with role=dialog and aria-modal=true.

anatomy.name: header
anatomy.description: Title, optional description, and optional governed close Icon Button.

anatomy.name: body
anatomy.description: Composable Body slot. Figma allows up to eight children; React runtime accepts authored public React content without inspecting business meaning.

anatomy.name: divider
anatomy.description: Subtle divider rendered with the optional actions region.

anatomy.name: actions
anatomy.description: Optional logical-end-aligned action region. Figma prefers Button sources and limits the design slot to three children; runtime leaves product action semantics to the workflow.

states.name: open
states.description: Controlled visible modal state supplied through open.

semantics.accessibleName: The required title is referenced by aria-labelledby. Optional description content is referenced by aria-describedby only when present.
semantics.keyboardActivation: Escape requests close; Tab and Shift+Tab remain contained within the open modal.
semantics.focus: On open, focus moves to initialFocusRef when valid, otherwise to the first focusable descendant or the dialog surface. On close, focus returns to the previously focused invoking control when it remains connected.
requirements: The open surface exposes role=dialog and aria-modal=true.
The required visible title owns the accessible name through aria-labelledby.
Optional description owns aria-describedby only while description is present.
Background document content outside the Dialog portal is inert and aria-hidden while the modal is open, then restored exactly on close.
Initial focus moves into the modal using initialFocusRef when supplied and contained, otherwise the first focusable descendant or the dialog surface.
Tab and Shift+Tab are contained within the dialog and wrap at the first and last focusable descendants.
Escape requests onOpenChange(false) whether or not the visible close Icon Button is shown.
The close Icon Button has a non-empty accessible label and requests onOpenChange(false) on native activation.
Backdrop or outside pointer activation does not dismiss Dialog in version 1.0.0; exit policy changes belong to a future explicit contract decision.
When controlled open becomes false, focus returns to the element that was focused immediately before opening when that element is still connected.
Dialog does not own requestStatus, pending state, validation, dirty checks, submission, or business outcomes; containing patterns and product logic own those decisions.
Hiding the close Icon Button never defines a pending-request Escape lock. Any temporary workflow dismissal restriction requires separate implementation and accessibility review.

body.description: Public React content rendered in the Figma Body slot. Dialog provides layout and modality only.

actions.description: Optional authored action content. Public Button composition is preferred; the workflow owns labels, hierarchy, enabled/pending behavior, and outcomes.

events.name: onOpenChange
events.trigger: close Icon Button activation or Escape key while open
